walkthroughs.body_html:
Logic & Problem Solving — a core area of A-Level Computer Science.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Logic & Problem Solving brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Logic & Problem Solving.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which gate outputs 1 only when both inputs are 1?
What does a NOT gate do to its input?
